usermeta.title: Deneb Calendar Heat Map (Multiple Languages)
usermeta.author: Greg Philps
usermeta.description: A heat map matrix of daily performance in a calendar layout (quarter months horizontally, quarters vertically)
usermeta.notes: language selection via slicer; week start date via slicer; daily metric selection via slicer
usermeta.template notes: usermeta object is used by the Deneb template generation process and is thus overwritten, hence added here as a comment

text.expr: slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'en' ? 'Deneb Calendar Heat Map' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'fr' ? 'Carte thermique du calendrier Deneb' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'es' ? 'Mapa de calor del calendario de Deneb' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'de' ? 'Deneb Kalender-Heatmap' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'it' ? 'Mappa di calore del calendario Deneb' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'pl' ? 'Mapa cieplna kalendarza Deneb' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'nl' ? 'Deneb Kalender Heatmap' : 'unknown'

title.subtitle: Transaction count by day by week by month by quarter

'Umsatz pro Tag, Woche, Monat, und Quartal' : slice( data('dataset')[0]['Culture'], 0, 2) == 'it' && data('dataset')[0]['Metric'] == 'Count' ?
